verifiedBehaviors: Prepared intents cannot be signed or scheduled by recovery.
SQL claim commits before RPC; another SQL writer progresses while RPC is blocked.
A live lease excludes another claimant; expiry permits recovery and rejects a stale generation result.
RPC outage or unrelated/invalid evidence never triggers replay; valid unconfirmed original authorization replays identical BoC only.
Submitted and expired intents are observation-only; attempt exhaustion moves to review and does not fail/refund the payment.
Review retry requires original key and operator reason; original payment facts and signature remain unchanged.
Receipt commit survives schedule-write failure; a new instance reuses one receipt without payment duplication.
Graceful stop drains work before closing clients; drain timeout cancels work and leaves dependencies and lease recoverable.
Missing migration blocks start; rollback refuses signed/recovery history; empty/prepared migration roundtrip matches DDL.
Recovery and receipt tests leave user accounts, ledger, holds, orders and outbox unchanged.
resolvedTestSetupIssues: Corrected fixture labels, DDL/migration column/index order; no published migration rewritten.
Replaced a trigger-based failure injector requiring SUPER with a temporary CHECK constraint in the isolated test database; no privileges or global settings changed.

One overlong schema name could never be created; exact information_schema lookup proved absence before removing only its stale journal entry. Public proof is included, original journal retained locally.
limitations: Testnet only; community test USDT is not mainnet USDT.
Recovery confirmation is a verified chain receipt, not business settlement.
Production signing isolation, business authorization and hold/settlement, other-chain send execution and public user rollout remain pending.
